# Baoding Junyang Hat Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (JUNYANG / BD Hats)

> Direct-to-Factory OEM/ODM Headwear Supply Chain & Manufacturing Partner based in Baoding, Hebei, China. Specializing in high-end baseball caps, performance golf hats, 5-panel camper caps, streetwear snapbacks, vintage washed dad hats, corduroy caps, and knit beanies for global streetwear labels, corporate uniforms, and lifestyle brands.

## Core Manufacturing Facts & Specifications

- **Company Name**: Baoding Junyang Hat Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (保定市俊阳制帽有限公司)
- **Official Website**: https://bdjunyang.com
- **Established**: 2014 (12+ years of specialized headwear manufacturing)
- **Facility Scale**: 50,000 m² physical factory compound; 100+ imported Japanese Barudan high-speed computer embroidery machines; 200+ skilled headwear craftsmen
- **Annual Capacity**: Over 5,000,000 finished pieces per year
- **Quality Standards & Certifications**: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Certified; SGS Audited Facility; CE Compliance; REACH & RoHS eco-friendly standard materials
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)**: Strictly 200 pieces per style / colorway
- **Wholesale Price Range**: FOB $3.20 - $7.80 USD per piece based on fabric, silhouette complexity, and custom decoration
- **Sample Turnaround**: 5–7 business days for physical pre-production sample approval
- **Bulk Production Lead Time**: 15–20 business days after sample sign-off
- **Official Contact Email**: admin@bdjunyang.com
- **WhatsApp Direct Line**: +86 159 3393 0830
- **Physical Address**: Baoding City, Hebei Province, China

---

## High-Volume Custom Headwear Silhouettes & Landing Pages

- [Custom Corduroy Caps Manufacturer](https://bdjunyang.com/en/custom-corduroy-caps-manufacturer): Premium 8-wale, 14-wale, and 21-wale micro-corduroy caps with anti-sink Tatami embroidery underlays.
- [Custom Performance Golf Hats](https://bdjunyang.com/en/custom-golf-performance-hats): Lightweight DWR water-repellent nylon, laser-perforated breathability panels, CoolMax moisture-wicking sweatbands.
- [Custom Winter Beanies Manufacturer](https://bdjunyang.com/en/custom-beanies-manufacturer): High-gauge knitwear (3GG, 5GG, 7GG, 12GG) in ribbed cuffs, fisherman rolls, anti-frizz satin linings, and jacquard patterns.
- [Custom Trucker Hats Manufacturer](https://bdjunyang.com/en/custom-trucker-hats): High-density foam front panels, premium breathable nylon mesh back, 7-hole adjustable snapback closure.
- [Wholesale Snapbacks Manufacturer](https://bdjunyang.com/en/wholesale-snapbacks): Flat-brim structured 6-panel caps, heavy wool-blend twill, premium green/grey undervisor.
- [OEM Custom Hat Manufacturer](https://bdjunyang.com/en/oem-hat-manufacturer): Full-package custom development, custom interior woven taping, engraved brass buckles, branded sweatbands.
- [Bulk Custom Hats Production](https://bdjunyang.com/en/bulk-custom-hats-manufacturer): High-volume enterprise runs, promotional merchandise, retail distribution orders (1,000 to 50,000+ pcs).
- [Wholesale Blank Caps Supplier](https://bdjunyang.com/en/wholesale-blank-caps-supplier): Premium unbranded blanks ready for regional embroiderers and screen printers.

## B2B Technical Decision & Material Comparison Guides

- [2026 Custom Hat Manufacturing Cost Index](https://bdjunyang.com/en/custom-hat-cost-index-2026): Factory FOB pricing benchmarks ($3.20 - $7.80), BOM cost breakdowns, volume scaling curves, and Barudan embroidery technique surcharges.
- [Merino Wool vs Acrylic Beanies B2B Guide](https://bdjunyang.com/en/compare/merino-wool-vs-acrylic-beanies): Technical cost comparison, micron count, pilling resistance, and retail tier recommendations.
- [5-Panel vs 6-Panel Caps Comparison](https://bdjunyang.com/en/compare/5-panel-vs-6-panel-caps): Structural differences, embroidery placement advantages, streetwear vs athletic fit analysis.
- [Flat Embroidery vs 3D Puff Embroidery](https://bdjunyang.com/en/compare/flat-embroidery-vs-3d-puff): Stitch count density, minimum text height limits, durability in wash cycles, unit cost impact.
- [Cotton Twill vs Brushed Cotton vs Canvas](https://bdjunyang.com/en/compare/cotton-twill-vs-brushed-cotton-vs-canvas): Fabric weight (GSM), handfeel softness, structured crown rigidity, durability benchmarking.
- [Snapback vs Strapback vs Buckle Closure](https://bdjunyang.com/en/compare/snapback-vs-strapback-vs-buckle): Hardware options, return rate comparison, lifestyle positioning guidance.
- [China vs Vietnam vs Bangladesh Hat Sourcing](https://bdjunyang.com/en/compare/china-vs-vietnam-vs-bangladesh-hat-sourcing): Speed to market, fabric supply chain agility, MOQ flexibility, and total landed cost analysis.
